purpose: Teach: 水路/電線/イスラーム/清浄/農法/明瞭/新約/精製

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、伝統水路、つまり水路灌漑の地理研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered a geography study of traditional waterways — canal irrigation — in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Composed teacher's opening, unhurried, pen-tap rhythm. An encouraging downward settle on the confirmation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、電線、つまり電線地中化の都市工学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I covered an urban-engineering study on power lines, on moving them underground.
lines.style: Eager, slightly rushed start, then self-correcting into precision. Small breath before the detail.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、イスラーム、つまりイスラーム圏の社会研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you took up social research on the Islamic world in a paper as well, I recall.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful delivery, a touch slower. Warm interest colored into the topic itself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、清浄、つまり清浄空間の建築学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote on architectural research into clean spaces, into keeping environments truly pure.
lines.style: Quickening with enthusiasm mid-line, careful landing on the technical phrase. Faint nervous energy.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、有機農法、つまり農法の比較研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also handled a comparative study of organic farming methods, didn't you.
lines.style: Even, appraising tone, like ticking down a well-kept list. Gentle rise inviting confirmation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、論理の明瞭さを評価する哲学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I covered a philosophy study that evaluates the clarity of an argument's logic.
lines.style: A little proud despite himself. Crisp articulation on clarity, tempo steadying with confidence.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新約聖書の文献研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And a textual study of the New Testament — you dealt with that in a paper too.
lines.style: Softly impressed, pace easing. The topic named with care, the question worn almost flat.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、石油精製、つまり精製プロセスの工学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I covered an engineering study of oil refining, of the refinement process itself.
lines.style: Satisfied final answer, slight exhale of relief. Neat, rounded close without trailing energy.
